hooks.text: 连续掷骰叠加连击与分数，但贪到失手会清空本回合全部收益
hooks.excerpt: The twist? Keep rolling to stack bigger combos and score more points, but push too far, and you’ll lose everything you’ve gained that turn.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 战斗间在商店扩充骰池，不同骰子会偏转概率、放大得分或反噬，并可用重掷补救
hooks.excerpt: You’ll begin each run with a simple set of dice, but between battles you’ll stop at shops to expand and refine your collection. Some dice tilt the odds in your favour, others amplify your scores, and a few can backfire entirely, unless you’ve saved enough re-rolls to turn the tide.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 十种武器会根本改变掷骰路线，可走稳定小伤或追逐极限大点数
hooks.excerpt: Wield one of 10 distinct weapons that fundamentally transform the way you play. Maybe you favour steady, smaller, but consistent hits, or perhaps you thrive on the thrill of chasing the biggest rolls?
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
